requirement: Mathematics is central to the intervention question population or outcome
decision_rule: Exclude from mathematics-specific synthesis when mathematics is only a covariate predictor or incidental context
evidence_required: Primary source locator showing the mathematics domain and its role

requirement: The computational technique or system is active and evaluated
decision_rule: Include only when a model algorithm data-mining AI/ML adaptive tutoring analytics automated assessment or explicitly evaluated computationally mediated intervention is documented; passive digitization or communication is insufficient
evidence_required: Primary source locator describing the technique and its evaluation

requirement: The source reports completed analyzable empirical results
decision_rule: Protocols proposals and project reports without completed analyzable results remain contextual or audit records and do not support empirical synthesis or a completed MMAT appraisal
evidence_required: Methods and results locator with an identifiable study outcome

requirement: Mathematics outcomes are separable or interpretable
decision_rule: A composite STEM outcome supports mathematics-specific synthesis only when the mathematics component is separately identifiable and analyzable
evidence_required: Outcome definition and results locator for the mathematics component

requirement: Identity year document type and peer-review status are verified
decision_rule: Record article conference dissertation thesis report and protocol categories separately; a high score does not convert a report or protocol into a peer-reviewed empirical article
evidence_required: Publisher or institutional source plus publication-type and peer-review evidence
